There is no one correct way to play GTAVI . Though this official walkthrough details specific steps for progression along with suggestions for encounters, we encourage you to experiment and complete objectives your own way. If you need more direction, though, we’ve got your back.

Chapter 1 – Just Like Paradise Walkthrough

There are 23 total story missions in the first chapter of GTA 6. Get chapter-specific notes and recommendations on the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips page.

The second chapter of GTA 6 has a total of 18 story missions . Find out more about this chapter on the Chapter 2 Guide and Tips page.

articles.title: Baptiste - Official Release Date Trailer | Horror Game Awards Fall 2026 - IGN
articles.summary: Get a fresh look at gameplay and more from Baptiste in this unsettling new trailer for the upcoming psychological horror game about a cursed doll and a haunted mansion. Baptiste will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam) on March 25, 2027.After a family tragedy, young Tom moves with his mother Sara into Jagged Shore Cliff, an isolated mansion hiding dark secrets. Inside a glass cabinet he finds Baptiste, a creepy doll with one warning attached: never let it out. He didn’t listen. Explore the haunted house through the eyes of a frightened child, uncover its past through notes and clues, solve puzzles and survive as doors stop behaving, floors begin to whisper and reality slowly falls apart, until you can no longer tell whether the terror is real or born from a grieving mind.

articles.title: Fallout-Themed AriZona Iced Tea Gets Black Friday Discount, Including New 'Apocalyptic Orange' Flavor
articles.body:
Amazon’s Black Friday sale is officially live , making it a great time to pick up some serious bulk of whatever your drink of choice is. Mine happens to be AriZona Iced Tea, because who can hate cheap caffeine, and I’ll certainly never complain about a deal dropping those prices even further.

The 15oz Fallout edition teas only come in 12-can packs, priced at around $2/can. Don’t worry, AriZona still maintains its 99-cent MSRP for non-licensed drinks — founder Don Vultaggio makes sure of that. The Amazon discount only knocks off a couple of bucks, but it brings every Fallout can closer to that beautiful standard price.

Amazon Discounts Fallout AriZona Green Tea Packs for Black Friday

AriZona x Fallout Energy Drink - Green Tea Variety Pack, 15 fl oz (12 Pack)

AriZona x Fallout Energy Drink - Pomegranate Green Tea - 15 fl oz (12 Pack)

AriZona x Fallout Energy Drink - Red Apple Green Tea - 15 fl oz (12 Pack)

AriZona x Fallout Energy Drink - Sweet Peach Green Tea - 15 fl oz (12 Pack)

AriZona x Fallout Energy Drink - Orange Green Tea - 15 fl oz (12 Pack)

The 15% discount is available on 12-can cases of individual flavors as well as the bulk variety pack. All packs have the same base price, so the decision really comes down to your flavor preferences.

Your Fallout options consist of three Vault-Tec reimaginings of AriZona classics – Atomic Red Apple, Wastelander Sweet Peach, and Power Pomegranate – and Apocalyptic Orange, a new flavor unique to the collaboration.

The flavors are tied to specific characters from Amazon’s live-action series, depicted in playing card illustrations on the packaging of each case. Lucy gets apple and the Ghoul gets peach, while Dogmeat and pre-war Ghoul adorn the low-cal versions.

The collaboration also doubled up on Maximus drinks, with orange dedicated to the man and pomegranate dedicated to his Power Armor. I guess it could be someone else in the suit, but I leave that up to your interpretation.

Fallout TV Show Video Game Easter Eggs – Vault-Tec / Iconography

Amazon’s Fallout TV show has brought a whole new audience to Bethesda’s post-apocalyptic world . The series aired its second season earlier this year, and a third season should be coming to Prime Video at some point in 2027.

Bethesda, on the other hand, has turned its attention back to the world of Elder Scrolls. The company announced Sentinel as the name of the next game, though it likely won’t arrive for several more years . Bethesda confirmed Fallout 5 won’t be coming until after the next Elder Scrolls, so it might be quite the wait until we get a new journey in the Wasteland.

Blythe (she/her) is an Audience Development Coordinator at IGN who spends way too much time in character customization screens and tracking down collectibles.

articles.title: Eureka Ergonomic Has Black Friday Deals to Give Your Space the Upgrade It Needs
articles.summary: Professional office or gamer vibes? The choice is yours.
articles.body:
If you’re trying to reinvigorate your office or gaming den with some fresh furniture, Eureka Ergonomic has a Black Friday sale on a whole host of gear that will let you go for a full redesign of your space without a full redesign of your budget.

Aero Pro Wing-Shaped Standing Desk (72"x23")

GTG-L60 Pro L-Shaped Glass Gaming Standing Desk (60"x23")

Ark SWS Pro Executive Standing Desk (63"x29")

Royal Renee Microfiber Leather Executive Office Chair

L-Shaped Standing Desk with Accessories Set (60"x23")

For the gaming den, Eureka Ergonomic’s Typhon II Hybrid Ergonomic Gaming Chair can help upgrade your comfort for short and lengthy gaming sessions alike. High density foam in the seat can support you for hours on end while an adjustable headrest, lumbar support, and armrests help ensure you’ve got solid ergonomics to stay comfortable and avoid the aches and pains that can come from prolonged sitting or a poor sitting arrangement. For Black Friday, Eureka Ergonomic is cutting $50 off to bring the Typhon II to just $399.

What better way to complete your gaming setup than with an upgraded desk. The Aero Pro Wing-Shaped Standing Desk is $140 off at $659 and gives you multiple levels of desk space with two tiers of wrap-around surface for easy access to anything on your desk and an articulating keyboard tray. Its dual motors let you easily shift the desk to multiple height levels as well, raising up as high as 48 inches. The whole main surface has a mouse pad so you can go for low-DPI, high-precision aim in the sweatiest games. Don’t worry about knocking your drink over when the firefight gets too frantic. The desk includes a cup holder and cable management tray.

If you’re squeezing into a corner, Eureka Ergonomic also has the GTG-L60 Pro L-shaped Glass Gaming Standing Desk on sale for $1199 after $300 off. This gets you a versatile standing desk with powerful motors, a cable tray, cable management accessories, cup and headphone holders, built-in USB charging ports, and substantial desk space. The desktop has a glass surface that’s lit underneath by LEDs that support 38 different lighting modes so you can dial in your gaming aesthetic.

When your space calls for something a little more reserved and professional, Eureka Ergonomic’s Black Friday sale still has you covered. The Ark SWS Pro Executive Standing Desk is $400 off and provides dark wood with brass accents, multiple tiers, and drawer storage. The Ark SD Standing Desk offers a lighter look with a rustic woodgrain top and white base. It also incorporates drawer storage and is $120 off.

Eureka Ergonomic's Forma and Royal Renee executive office chairs give you a classy pairing for those desks. The Forma focuses on ergonomics with multiple padded sections to support your legs, back, shoulders, and neck. The Royal Renee gives you a fully padded seat and adjustable lumbar pillow in an elegant, microfiber leather finish. Both are $100 off for Black Friday.

For an especially economic and ergonomic upgrade, Eureka Ergonomic has the Lira Office Chair for $399 after $100 off and its L-Shaped Standing Desk for $599 after $140 off. The Lira offers a large, high-density sponge base for soft and breathable support. It has an adjustable back rest to fit the curves of your back for hours-long comfort, and all sits on a sturdy aluminum base. Meanwhile the L-Shaped Standing Desk gives you a bit of everything. You get capable motors to let you easily shift from sitting to standing with the option to save three preferred heights. It has one large L-shaped surface to hold desktop PCs, laptops, consoles — you name it. A second platform above it can hold your monitor and integrates RGB lighting to illuminate the desk surface below. Underneath, the desk includes a slide-out keyboard tray, cup holder, and headphone hanger.

With these Black Friday deals from Eureka Ergonomic , you can set yourself up well for a new year of work and play.

Eric Song is the IGN commerce manager in charge of finding the best gaming and tech deals every day. When Eric isn't hunting for deals for other people at work, he's hunting for deals for himself during his free time.

articles.title: Percy Jackson Actors Reveal They Watched Attack on Titan Fan Edits to Help Themselves Cry While Filming Emotional Scenes
articles.summary: Walker Scobell and Aryan Simhadri revealed that they would watch Attack on Titan fan edits to help them prepare to film emotional scenes for Percy Jackson and the Olympians.
articles.body:
Walker Scobell and Aryan Simhadri revealed that they would watch Attack on Titan fan edits to help them prepare to film emotional scenes for Percy Jackson and the Olympians.

Attack on Titan is one of the most popular anime series in the world, in no small part due to its tragic storylines and brutal, gory battles. It’s been more than a decade since the anime first released in 2013, and fans have been making AMVs of their favorite characters ever since — but these fans probably didn’t know that their creations would help high-profile actors tap into their emotions.

Speaking at 92NY on a live episode of Josh Horowitz’s Happy Sad Confused podcast, Walker Scobell revealed his unique method for getting himself into an emotional state in preparation for sad scenes while filming Percy Jackson and the Olympians .

Percy Jackson Season 1: Episodes 1-8 Gallery

Scobell said that he would watch fan-made edits for Eren and Mikasa, two of Attack on Titan’s main characters, set to the opening song of Season 3, Red Swan.

“I was trying to get sad. I was in school, and I snuck my phone in. I was like, ‘What can I do to make myself cry?’ I searched up a bunch of — and he did the exact same thing, and we just figured this out yesterday,” Scobell said, pointing to co-star Aryan Simhadri.

“We didn’t communicate this at all. We just ended up doing it,” Simhardi confirmed.

“I thought of the saddest thing I could, and I searched up Eren and Mikasa edits from Attack on Titan,” Scobell continued. “I started crying at school, watching them to Red Swan. And then I got there [on set], and I couldn’t do it.”

Walker & Aryan saying they watch eren & mikasa edits so they can cry on set is actually frying meee 😭😭😭 — ELON SMD (@pearlinasbeau) November 20, 2026

Walker & Aryan saying they watch eren & mikasa edits so they can cry on set is actually frying meee 😭😭😭

Fans in the crowd had excited reactions to this revelation, as did fans online when clips from the episode made their way on social media shortly thereafter.

“Their tragedy is so profounddd everyone can feel it… oh they really are modern day Romeo and Juliet,” one fan wrote on X/Twitter.

“Red Swan is a Top 3 OP, I don’t blame him,” another said.

“The way they're emotionally regulating through anime edits on a professional set is the most Gen Z actor thing I've ever heard,” another remarked.

It’s no wonder that actors take notes from Attack on Titan for their own projects; in fact, Eren’s English voice actor, Bryce Papenbrook, revealed that he literally unhinged his jaw while screaming in one of the anime’s most iconic scenes in an effort to really sell the character’s pain and confusion.

Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3, The Titan’s Curse , is streaming on Disney+ and Hulu right now with new episodes dropping every Friday through December 11, 2026.

articles.title: The Official Lord of the Rings Pizza Cutter Drops to a New Low Price at Amazon
articles.body:
Amazon's Black Friday sale is a great time to find discounts on things you actually need. It's also a great time to buy expensive gifts for yourself that you absolutely don't need. Somewhere in between those two extremes is where I like to do most of my online window shopping, which is what led me to this discount on the official Lord of the Rings Pizza Wheel.

Amazon is currently offering a 20% discount, which drops the price down to $159.99 for the first time ever. It's a very expensive pizza cutter for sure, but it's also one of the coolest LOTR gifts for your kitchen you'll find anywhere.

Dalstrong Pizza Wheel - Lord of the Rings

As someone who makes a lot of pizzas at home, I can attest to how important it is to have a good pizza cutter at your disposal. If you don't have a sharp enough blade, toppings get crushed and pepperonis do that thing where they disappear into the cracks of every cut. You're only going to get good pizza slices if you have a knife capable of cutting good slices.

Dalstrong, the brand who makes this product, uses high-quality German X50CrMoV15 steel for their knives and pizza cutters. This gives them solid toughness and corrosion resistance that will help keep the blade sharper for longer. This type of steel isn't going to hold an edge nearly as long as the high-end Japanese variety, but it's fairly easy to sharpen and hone at home if the edge does get dull. Just don't go putting it in the dishwasher!

As for the LOTR stuff that actually makes this pizza cutter cool, there's a lot to love in the design. The handle is made of ebony wood and copper accents with the Leaf of Lórien carved into it. The blade itself is left bare to ensure drag-free cutting, but both sides include different designs etched into the steel. On one side you get silhouettes of the members of The Fellowship of the Ring and on the other side you get an inscription written in Elvish. I can't actually read Elvish, but I hope it just says pizza multiple times.

The pizza wheel also comes with a collector's pin and a leather sheath to help protect the blade. The whole thing ships in the kind of premium gift packaging that you'd expect from a nearly $200 pizza cutter.

The 4K Movie Trilogy Is Also on Sale Today

The Lord of the Rings: The Motion Picture Trilogy

Amazon also has a great deal on the 4K collection going on right now that's worth checking out. This includes both the theatrical and extended editions of the film in full 4K UHD. If you're only streaming these movies with an HBO Max subscription, you're missing out on the full visual experience.

Jacob Kienlen is a Senior Audience Development Strategist and Writer for IGN. Born and raised in Portland, Oregon, he has considered the Northwest his home for his entire life. With a bachelor's degree in communication and 10 years of professional writing experience, his expertise is spread across a variety of different pop culture topics — from TV series to books and the latest LEGO sets .
